assumptions.reference_compute_reservation: elastic: ceil(max(minimum quota, quota needed for latency and throughput)); capability test uses all currently remaining quota as an upper budget, not a promise at the minimum quota alone
assumptions.memory_capacity_conversion: floor(vendor_nominal_GB * 1000000000 / 1048576), conservative offline accounting assumption, not live allocatable VRAM
assumptions.bandwidth_share: remaining compute reservation fraction is used as a synthetic proportional bandwidth budget; vGPU software does not guarantee this isolation
assumptions.task_type_contention: none modeled; existing training/inference counts are input features but no invented measured interference coefficient
assumptions.interpretation: abstract reference operations and SLOs chosen before fitting; neither named-model benchmarks nor observed performance

workloads.name: FP32 compute-intensive training-step reference
workloads.description: Abstract forward/backward/update step; fixed resident tensors and optimizer budget. No real model has been executed.

workloads.name: FP32 memory-intensive batch-1 inference reference
workloads.description: Abstract request reading 2.5 decimal GB of weights/activations, approximately 625 million FP32 values, with 60 GFLOP work and a 4 GiB resident budget. No real model has been executed.
